question: top 5 customers by revenue
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 products by sale, top revenue generating regions by revenue, top returnble products along with their combined revenue
sql:
SELECT
    p.id AS product_id,
    p.name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: top 5 products by sale, top revenue generating regions by revenue, top returnble products along with their combined revenue
sql:
SELECT c.region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: top 5 products by sale, top revenue generating regions by revenue, top returnble products along with their combined revenue
sql:
SELECT p.id,
       p.name,
       COUNT(r.id) AS return_count,
       SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS combined_revenue
FROM returns r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY return_count DESC, combined_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: Prepare a report on the sales of the top 5 products by sale, including each product's ID, name, and total revenue.
sql:
SELECT p.id, p.name
FROM products p
WHERE p.id IN (
    SELECT oi.product_id
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
    ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
ORDER BY p.id;
